description: This file is a configuration script for Vitest, a testing framework for JavaScript/TypeScript projects. It merges default and custom configuration settings for running tests in a project that uses Vite as the build tool.

methods.name: mergeConfig
methods.description: Merges two or more Vitest configuration objects into one, allowing custom test configuration.

methods.name: defineConfig
methods.description: Defines a Vitest configuration object with type checking and auto-completion support.

methods.name: configDefaults
methods.description: Provides default configuration values for Vitest, used here to extend or override defaults.
